summary: Bug hunt: build, lint and all smoke tests pass, live site up. Fixed a broken-image bug on the Channels page's Launch review and added the Channels and Scorecard pages to the smoke tests.
why: Channels and Scorecard were not covered by the smoke tests; covering them showed the sample contact sheet had no fallback when it can't load.

findings.title: Channels: sample contact sheet showed a broken image
findings.detail: When a sample's preview can't be fetched (not committed yet, or GitHub refused) the Launch review showed a broken-image icon; now a plain note.

findings.title: Channels and Scorecard missing from smoke tests
findings.detail: Both added; every page also checked with each live channel selected in the switcher.

changes.title: Channels: contact-sheet fallback; smoke tests cover Channels and Scorecard
